tool.name: Google Antigravity
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.
tool.description: Google agent-first development platform (desktop app, IDE, CLI, SDK) on Gemini; replaced consumer Gemini Code Assist in June 2026.
tool.pricing: Free tier with weekly quotas; higher quotas with Google AI Pro/Ultra plus opt-in AI credit overages; enterprise via Google Cloud consumption billing or Gemini Enterprise Standard/Plus licenses.
tool.statusNote: Launched in public preview on 2025-11-20. Since 2026-06-18, consumer Gemini Code Assist and Gemini CLI users are directed to Antigravity; Gemini Code Assist Standard/Enterprise access is unchanged.
tool.practitionerNote: For enterprise use, sign in via a Google Cloud project or Gemini Enterprise license so Google Cloud terms, VPC Service Controls and regional endpoints apply; consumer sign-ins do not carry those controls. Organisational contract tiers are not yet supported.

dataResidency.detail: Enterprise path supports regional data residency and VPC Service Controls with global, us and eu endpoints; consumer plans not covered.

deployment.detail: Desktop/IDE/CLI clients with Google-hosted Gemini models via consumer plans or a Google Cloud project; no self-hosted models.

auditLogging.detail: On the enterprise path, telemetry and model interactions route to the customer Google Cloud project (request-response logging); no product-level audit log documented for consumer plans.

soc2.detail: No Antigravity-specific SOC 2 scope statement found at review time.

iso27001.detail: No Antigravity-specific ISO 27001 scope statement found at review time.

iso42001.detail: No Antigravity-specific ISO 42001 scope statement found at review time.

euAiAct.detail: Assessed limited-risk by product category (general-purpose assistant); no published Google EU AI Act conformity statement for this product.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary Google product; Gemini and Google Cloud lock-in.
